government-business-services.heroTitle: Government Business Loan Schemes in India

sections.heading: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
sections.intro: This scheme offers collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: Small manufacturers, service sector units, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, truck operators, food-service units, repair shops, machine operators, small industries, artisans, food processors, etc.

sections.heading: Stand-Up India Scheme
sections.intro: Provides loans ranging from ₹10 lakhs to ₹1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for setting up new enterprises.

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: SC/ST or women entrepreneurs holding at least 51% stake in a new business or partnership firm.

sections.heading: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
sections.intro: Offers collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises (MSEs).

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: New and existing MSEs (excluding retail trade, educational institutions, agriculture, and SHGs).

sections.heading: SIDBI Make in India Soft Loan Fund for MSMEs (SMILE)
sections.intro: Provides soft loans to new and existing MSMEs for business expansion.

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: New and existing enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors.

sections.heading: Bank Credit Facilitation Scheme (by NSIC)
sections.intro: Implemented by NSIC, this scheme helps MSMEs obtain credit support from banks without additional fees.

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: Registered MSMEs across India.

sections.heading: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
sections.intro: Provides financial assistance to establish new micro-enterprises.

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: Individuals above 18 years of age looking to set up a new enterprise.
